title: 계란 노른자 구출 작전

cuts.scene: Kitchen. The wife rabbit, frustrated, looking at a broken egg yolk in a bowl. Her ears are drooped. A messy kitchen counter is behind her.
Kitchen. The husband sloth, leaning lazily against a cabinet, holding a newspaper. He glances over at the wife with a dry expression.
Kitchen. The wife rabbit picks up 'the real product' from a pile of mail on the counter, her eyes wide with curiosity.
Kitchen. The wife rabbit, with a surprised expression, uses 'the real product' to separate an egg yolk perfectly. Her ears perk up.
Kitchen. The husband sloth sips his coffee slowly, looking at the wife with a knowing smirk. He doesn't move much.
A clean, bright studio. The guide character stands next to a floating card showing 'the real product'. A '글쎄' stamp appears on the card.
Kitchen. The wife rabbit, still holding 'the real product', looks around for more items, her gaze drifting towards a drawer.
Kitchen. The husband sloth, still leaning against the cabinet, sighs softly, looking at the wife with a tired but resigned expression. The broken egg is still in the bowl.

situation: 아침 계란 요리 중 노른자 터짐
